place.summary: Lan Fong Yuen functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is TW. It receives notable inbound connections from Central. Visitors often continue to Hong Kong Disneyland. Its observed experience trails the category average, despite existing visitor demand.
